introduction:
In Telangana, the Ration Card is officially termed as the Food Security Card (FSC). It is issued by the Department of Consumer Affairs, Food & Civil Supplies, Government of Telangana. The FSC guarantees highly subsidized or free essential commodities (rice, wheat, sugar) through the State's ePOS-enabled Public Distribution System.

The Food Security Card serves as a paramount identity and socio-economic proof for availing welfare schemes like Arogyasri Health Insurance, Fee Reimbursement, and housing schemes in Telangana.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Purpose: To apply for a New Food Security Card (Ration Card) or add a new family member to an existing card in Telangana.
  • State: Telangana
  • Processing Time: Typically takes between 15 to 45 days for the application to be processed and approved.
  • Target Audience: Residents of Telangana looking to apply for a new card or update family members (e.g., after marriage or birth).
  • Key Requirement: The applicant's Aadhaar card details (like name, age, address, and biometric data) must be fully updated in the SRDH (State Resident Data Hub) database before applying.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for Food Security Card (FSC)

For a New Ration Card (FSC)
  1. Duly filled Application Form
  2. Aadhaar Card Xerox copies of all family members
  3. Latest Gas Bill OR Electricity Bill (as Address Proof)
  4. Your local Fair Price (FP) Shop Number / Ration Shop Number (You can find this at your nearest ration shop board)
For Adding a New Member to an Existing Card
  1. Duly filled Application Form
  2. Aadhaar Card Xerox of the member to be added
  3. Online printout of the current Ration Card (FSC Online Print)
  4. Latest Gas Bill
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Hybrid Mode (Download Online, Submit Offline)

Note: The process in Telangana is a hybrid model. You can download the application form online, but you must submit it physically.
Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1 (Download Form): Search for the "Telangana MeeSeva Portal" on Google. Go to the "Application Forms" section. Under "Civil Supplies," find and download the "Application for New Food Security Card" PDF.
  2. Step 2 (Fill the Form): Print the form and fill it manually:
    • Head of Household: Usually, the senior-most female member (Mother or Wife) is selected. Fill in her Aadhaar number, name, spouse/father name, gender, age, religion, and social status.
    • Gas Connection Details: Mention if you have a connection, the status (single/double cylinder), company name (HPCL, BPCL, IOCL), agency name, and consumer number.
    • Residence Address: Fill in your full address matching your proofs, including district, mandal, village/ward, and pin code.
    • FP Shop No: Enter the number of the ration shop nearest to your residence.
    • Add Member Details: List all family members to be included. You need their Aadhaar number, Name, Name as per SRDH, Age, Gender, and Relation to the Head of the Family.
    • Informant Details: Fill in the details of the person submitting the form, along with the proofs attached, and sign the document.
  3. Step 3 (Submission Visit): Take the filled form and all the required Xerox copies of your documents to your nearest MeeSeva Center, Mandal Revenue Office (MRO), or Municipal Office.
  4. Step 4 (Data Entry): The officials there will scan your documents, enter the details into their online database, and provide you with an Application/Reference Number.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Complete Offline Application

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Visit Center/Office: Visit your nearest MeeSeva Center or Mandal/Taluk Office.
  2. Get Physical Form: Ask for the physical "New Food Security Card Application Form" (Civil Supplies department).
  3. Fill Details: Fill out the application form with a pen with all the details mentioned in the hybrid section above.
  4. Attach Documents: Attach the physical photocopies of all required documents (Aadhaar cards of all members, address proof, gas/electricity bill).
  5. Submit Form: Submit the application form and documents to the operator at the MeeSeva center or the concerned officer at the Mandal office.
  6. Pay Fee: Pay any required nominal processing fee.
  7. Collect Receipt: Collect your acknowledgment receipt containing the Application Reference Number. Keep this safe for future tracking.
afterApplying:
After Applying — Process & Status Tracking

Wait Time

Wait for approximately 15 to 45 days for the backend verification and approval process to be completed.

Track Status Online

To track your status:

  1. Search for "Food Security Card Telangana" or go to the official EPDS portal.
  2. Look for the "FSC Search" or "FSC Application Search" option.
  3. Select the option to search by "Application No" or "MeeSeva No".
  4. Enter the reference number given to you during submission.
Understanding Status Outcomes

The portal will display your current status: Approved, Pending, or Rejected. If the application is rejected, the system will display the exact reason for rejection so you can correct it and reapply.
